paths.naming: INI groups [port 1]..[port 4]; per port: controller N=standard|zapper|snes mouse|arkanoid paddle|disable, pad N type=auto|original|3rdparty, PNJ GUID=<SDL joystick GUID or NULL>, PNK A/B/Select/Start/Up/Down/Left/Right/TurboA/TurboB=<Qt key name>, P1 TA Delay/P1 TB Delay=[shortcuts] group holds hotkeys; joystick bindings are stored per-device GUID, never fuzzy-matched
<ROM basename with extension stripped>.prb — raw WRAM/NVRAM image written on power-off/ROM change (and every 180 s if 'save battery ram file every 180 sec=yes')

paths.naming: <ROM basename>.pXX with XX = two hex digits of the slot index, slots 0..11 so .p00..p0B (12 slots); NSF playback uses .nXX
evidence: source:src/core/save_slot.c name_slot_file = gui_data_folder() + SAVE_FOLDER + basename, ext ".p%02X" (".n%02X" for NSF)
